Based only on the search results you provided, my top pick is the UGREEN Nexode Pro 65W for travel, with the Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W) as a strong alternative.

Top 3 picks
Best overall for travel

1. UGREEN Nexode Pro 65W

65W · 3 ports · 113g

Delivers 65W when charging one device.

Splits power between laptop and phone at 45W + 20W.

Includes US, UK and EU plug heads, according to the supplied review.

Best balance of portability and versatility.

Source: Smart Gadget Kit

Find buying options

Best alternative

2. Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W)

65W · 2 USB-C + 1 USB-A · Foldable plug

Supports USB Power Delivery and PPS.

Can charge a laptop and phone simultaneously.

When two USB-C ports are used, power is split 45W + 20W.

The supplied Newegg listing shows $29.99, sold by Anker Official Store.

Sources: Anker specifications · Newegg listing

Buy from Newegg

3. Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W 2-pack

65W · 2 USB-C + 1 USB-A · Two chargers

Supports USB PD 3.0, PPS and QC 3.0.

Two USB-C devices share power at 45W + 20W.

Includes two chargers for home and travel.

Supplied price: $49.99 for the 2-pack.

Source: Dealectric review

Buy the 2-pack

Which one should you buy?

Your priority

	

Recommendation




Best compact travel setup

	

UGREEN Nexode Pro 65W




Lower listed price

	

Anker 735 at $29.99




Two chargers for two locations

	

Baseus GaN5 Pro 2-pack




Samsung PPS fast charging

	

UGREEN or Baseus; Anker also supports PPS

My verdict: Choose the UGREEN Nexode Pro 65W if portability and international travel matter most. Choose the Anker 735 if you want a versatile three-port charger at the lowest listed price.

One important caveat: when charging a laptop and phone together, these chargers typically allocate only 45W to the laptop. That is generally suitable for a MacBook Air, but a laptop requiring 65W may charge more slowly. If you tell me your laptop and phone models, I can narrow this down to the best match.
